records.name: Angular UTable
records.purpose: Data table with controlled sorting, filtering, selection, row editing, expansion, grouping and composed paging/windowing.
records.surface: Selector u-table; standalone UTable<T>. Inputs value: T[]=[], dataKey="", columns: UTableColumn<T>[]=[], sortMode: SortMode="single", sortField?: string, sortOrder: 1|0|-1=0, multiSortMeta: SortMeta[]=[], filters: Record<string,FilterMetadata|FilterMetadata[]>={}, selectionMode?: SelectionMode, selection?: T|T[], compareSelectionBy: "equals"|"deepEquals"="equals", selectionColumn=false, paginator=false, first=0, rows=0, totalRecords=0, rowsPerPageOptions?: number[], virtualScroll=false, virtualScrollItemSize=0, lazy=false, lazyLoadOnInit=false, editMode?: "cell"|"row", editingRowKeys: Record<string,boolean>={}, expandedRowKeys: Record<string,boolean>={}, rowGroupMode?: "subheader"|"rowspan", groupRowsBy?: string, loading=false. Outputs sortFieldChange: string|undefined, sortOrderChange: 1|0|-1, multiSortMetaChange: SortMeta[], selectionChange: T|T[], firstChange/rowsChange: number, onLazyLoad: {first:number;last:number}, editingRowKeysChange/expandedRowKeysChange: Record<string,boolean>, onRowExpand/onRowCollapse: {originalEvent:Event;data:T}. UTableColumn<T=unknown> defines field/header:string and body?: (row:T,options:{field:string;rowIndex:number})=>string; this exported source interface is not re-exported by the barrel. tableStyleModule wraps @ultimate/uix-styles/table and is also source-only. Public registerCustomFilter(fn: (value:unknown,filter:unknown,filterLocale?:string)=>boolean): void replaces an instance-local custom predicate; filterLocale is passed undefined. Public initRowEdit(row:T,event?:Event):void enters internal row editing. ngOnChanges reconciles first and editingRowKeys. Pipeline is filter-then-sort-then-paginate; grouping sorts the paged view with groupRowsBy leading. Filter arrays are OR alternatives per field, fields AND together; supported modes include contains/startsWith/notContains/endsWith/equals/notEquals/lt/lte/gt/gte/between/in/notIn/dateIs/dateIsNot/custom. Sorting emits ascending state rather than cycling or mutating controlled inputs. Selection emits controlled state, equals uses dataKey and deepEquals uses structural comparison; header select-all uses all value rows. Editing stores drafts and committed overrides without mutating value; save/cancel are protected handlers. Expansion emits controlled maps and renders an empty placeholder row. Non-virtual mode has headers with aria-sort, focusable rows with aria-selected, loading marker, fixed DEFAULT_EMPTY_MESSAGE="No results found" (not an input), selection controls, expansion and row-edit actions. ArrowUp/Down/Home/End move among mounted sibling rows; Space/Enter select and Ctrl/Cmd+A select all in multiple mode, with child-control guards. Virtual mode composes UScroller with filteredValue, itemSize, lazy and a #content template, renders absolute-index cells without non-virtual headers/edit/expansion controls, and navigation is limited to mounted rows. UPaginator receives first/rows/totalRecords and updates internal cursor plus emits firstChange/rowsChange. rowsPerPageOptions is declared but not forwarded or otherwise read; lazyLoadOnInit is declared but not read. Only @ultimate/ng#UTable is public; no manifest ./table entry or barrel UTableColumn export. No Aura table registry entry exists; shared CSS and base token registration establish styling relationships without inventing a table preset. TABLE_METADATA links the Angular source; table.api.mdx is generated supporting documentation. All components extend UBaseComponent with inherited dt?: Record<string,unknown> and unstyled?: boolean; base ngOnInit registers theme variables and structural CSS. Local style modules and their css/classes constants and inline class-parameter types are source-only, owned by this family. Remaining private/protected state, lifecycle methods, render handlers and helpers belong to the owning record. No additional directive, hook, factory or base class is declared in these roots. Metadata source references establish relationships, not proof of runtime completeness. Manifest dist targets declare availability, not verified publication or installed artifact integrity. Prime comments are neutral provenance references only.

records.purpose: Page navigation driven by record offset, page size and record count.
records.surface: Selector u-paginator; standalone UPaginator. Inputs first=0, rows=0, totalRecords=0, pageLinkSize=5; output onPageChange: PaginatorPageChangeEvent. Public changePage(first:number):void calculates page=floor(first/rows) when rows>0, otherwise zero; accepts only 0<=page<pageCount, updates internal _first then emits. records.name: Angular UScroller
records.purpose: Vertical virtual viewport with optional consumer content template and lazy range notifications.
records.surface: Selector u-scroller; standalone UScroller. Inputs items: unknown[]=[], itemSize=0, numToleratedItems?: number=undefined, loading?: boolean=undefined, disabled=false, lazy=false. Output onLazyLoad: {first:number;last:number}. Public scrollTo(options:ScrollToOptions):void calls root scrollTo; scrollToIndex(index:number,behavior:ScrollBehavior="auto"):void maps index*itemSize to top. Public UScrollerContentContext contains $implicit: {index:number;value:unknown}[] and options with getItemOptions(index) returning index/count:number and first/last/even/odd:boolean, itemSize:number and loading:boolean. ContentChild("content",{descendants:false}) accepts an optional TemplateRef<UScrollerContentContext>; otherwise built-in div items render values. Browser-only ngAfterViewInit measures offsetHeight, registers ResizeObserver and updates the reactive content-size signal; ngOnDestroy disconnects. Viewport and last use calculateNumItemsInViewport/calculateLast from @ultimate/uix-data; default tolerated items ceil(viewport/2), last clamps to item count, and visible items retain absolute indices. Scroll computes first=floor(scrollTop/(itemSize||1)); on changed first with lazy, emits captured range in Promise.resolve().then(); no initial lazy event is issued. disabled bypasses windowing to return all items. Vertical-only structural CSS sets overflow and absolute content/items, content height equals items.length*itemSize, loading adds loader and aria-busy. scrollerStyleModule wraps @ultimate/uix-styles/virtualscroller plus local structural CSS. No Aura scroller registry entry exists; base token registration and imported CSS are recorded without inventing a preset.
